name: The verbal sentence
definition: A sentence that begins with a verb. At its simplest it is a verb and its doer (fāʿil).
body: قَامَ زَيْدٌ (Zayd stood), كَتَبَ الطَّالِبُ الدَّرْسَ (the student wrote the lesson). The verb comes first, then the doer, then, for a verb that takes one, the object.
When the doer is a noun after the verb, the verb stays singular in the usage the books follow: قَامَ الرِّجَالُ (the men stood).
